TextEng: "Hey there, ye said ye'd sail with me as far as Calimshan, aye? Well we won't get there with ye just lollygagging about, now, will we?"

"Aye, and ye ain't the Captain, neither. So, until ye are, ye'd best either help when I say help or swim when I say shark. Ye didn't have enough to pay yer passage but I be a kind enough man to let ye work off the remainder, so don't ye forget it."
"Nisar knows the port well, so he be the one to ask if ye have any questions. Now do you need any supplies to get the job done or are you ready to get a move on?"
"Fair enough, <lad/lass>. Now go see what's up at the Silver Sails."
"Hey, stop yer skulking about in search of shadows. I don't know what yer game be but if ye want to reach Calimshan so badly, ye'd best pitch in and help us set sail."
"Hey, ye lout, I be payin' ye for yer labors, not yer laziness. If ye wish to be in proper shape for the arenas of Calimshan, ye'd best help us get there."
"Hey, <Class>, ye said ye were sailin' with me from Luskan as far as the temples in Calimshan, weren't ye? Well, we ain't sailin' anywhere with ye just lollygagging about."

"Well, go! Time's a-wastin', <lad/lass>. It be almost dawn and the Rose sails then, with you or without. Now be there some reason ye're standin' 'ere gapin' at me instead of gettin' that cargo aboard?"

"Seven hells! I knew that commission was going to cause trouble! Right. Out with it, then: what be the hold up? Is Martins in his cups again or could he not find enough able hands to move the bloody thing?"

"Why, the red-ribbed, bilge-sucking chunks of sharkbait! ...Well, I can't spare another shipmate for it, now, can I? Either convince the men already hired to do what Martins paid 'em for or come up with some other means of getting it aboard."
"Right, then. Best ye get to it. We still have a lot of work to do if we hope to sail by sunrise!"

"Aye and true enough. With a tongue as loose as his, people seem to listen to his superstitious gab. Like as not, he's holed up in the Seedy Tavern as we speak, tradin' his ghost stories for a pint of ale rather than loadin' that cargo like I asked."
"Don't look at me, Cap'n. I had nothin' to do with this..."

"We've got some work to do here. I sent Martins to pick up a mage by the name of Rahman Madani at the Silver Sails but I've seen neither hide nor hair of 'em in the hour since. Get out there and drag 'em in by the ear so we can hoist anchor, will ye?"
"Have ye any news? I've yet to see either Martins or the cargo."
"Right, then. Best ye get to it. We still have a lot of work to do if we hope to sail by sunrise!"

"Drinkin' away my gold, I imagine. Not the first time I've had to leave him in port but if I had my druthers, it'll be the last. Ye've just got yourself a promotion, <lad/lass>. Second Mate sound good enough on ye? How was the poor chap anyway?"

"Aye now, seafarers be a supertitious lot but Martins was the worst of us all. Sometimes ye just 'ave to leave sea dogs to their curses and raise anchor all the same. Bring that cargo aboard. If it made it this far, a short trip by sea won't hurt it, aye?"
"Good to see ye back. Ye got the cargo straightened out, I see. Well, there be... ah... There be one more thing what needs takin' care of before we raise anchor."
"It be a last minute addition to the passenger list, is all. Some crazy lass staying at the Golden Apple just requested passage on the Rose. Her name be Tasina or some such."

"I thank ye. If the lass hadn't sent fare with the messenger, I wouldn't have bothered to grant her passage. Anyhow, go find her o'er at the Golden Apple and hurry her aboard. 3,000 coins or no, I'll can't hold back the tides."

"Har, I should be so lucky, mate! I'm letting a paying customer take passage, that's all. If anyone sees fit to complain, let them be the ones to buy the rum... The lass sent 3,000 coins down here with a messenger just a moment ago... 3,000 coins!"

"Nay, me first love will always be me Midnight Rose but her dalliances have ne'er come cheap. Anyhow, go find this Tasina lass o'er at the Golden Apple, and hurry her aboard. 3,000 coins or no, I can't hold back the tides."
"They're payin' you now, are they, Cap'n?"

"Aye, then ye won't be aboard the Midnight Rose when she sets sail for yer precious Calimshan, either... I'll tell ye what, <FirstName>. Do this for me now and maybe I'll hire you on for real once Calimshan's behind us."
"If I had a copper for every time I heard you say that..."
"Mind yer lip, Nisar, or I'll cut it off an' boil it up for soup as soon as we leave port."
"Tasina should be in the Golden Apple. Go see what's keeping her and hurry her aboard. The sun soon rises o'er Neverwinter and with it go the tides."
"There ye be! That Tasina lass be aboard, safe and sound, thanks to your help."
"Looks like things be all taken care of, thanks to yer help. I owe ye a small debt for the day's troubles, to be fair. Take a quick break an' clean up any loose ends 'ere, if ye feel the notion."
"Miss Alcrest? The lass seems a bit quiet to me but she's got dress and jewels to mark her a noble, right enough. Yet when young William snuck a peek at her ankles as she came aboard..."

"Well, she told 'im to keep 'is peepers on the prow or she'd send 'im down to Fiddler's Green, all fast and quick. I ain't ever heard a land-lovin' noble lass talk like that before. Passing strange, I say. Now what was it ye wanted to tell me, <lad/lass>?"
"If ye're sure, <lad/lass>, if ye're sure... Now hurry up with whatever it is that's keeping you, <lad/lass>! We sail before mornin' light!"
"Shh! Pipe down, <lad/lass>! Does yer honor good for tellin' me but the guards already came by to tell me of what happened. They said ye put up a good fight against the scallywags, too."

"I'm not sure what trouble our passenger be in but, as long as she keep it to herself, 3,000 coins means I ain't fool enough to ask. Ye think she be the only one on the Midnight Rose with happenin's they'd like to keep stashed in the past?"
"Aye, and the price be passage to Calimshan, deckswabber, now don't ye forget it. Do yer work well and without complaint and ye may yet get some actual gold out of me once Calimshan's behind us."
"As long as her coin be good and it isn't the guard who's after her, she's done all right by me. Now hurry up with whatever it is that's keeping you, <lad/lass>! We sail before mornin' light!"
"If I remember a'right, I was the one doin' the most o' it..."
"Aye, as I have a mind to do so myself, Cap'n!"
"Let me know when ye're ready to sail <lad/lass>. We'll be underway as soon as ye're ready to leave this port."
"Fine, but don't lollygag around too much more. We're goin' to miss the mornin' tide if we sit 'ere much longer."
"Don't worry, Cap'n. I'll keep <him/her> out o' trouble."
"Right, then. Weigh anchor, men! It's back to open waters for the likes o' us!"

"Ye be a good <lad/lass>, <FirstName>, and the winds have blown fairer since we left Luskan with you aboard. We'll get you off to Calimshan as soon as we finish our business 'ere in Neverwinter. If ye wish to sail with us further, the offer stands."
"Nisar, go with <FirstName> and find what's keepin' Martins. Pray he's at the Silver Sails where he's supposed to be and not wettin' his boots at a tavern."

"<He/She>'s barely got <his/her> sea legs yet, Captain. What if there's trouble? It's better I sniff out Martins myself than be stuck playing nursemaid for the <lad/lass>. I haven't found a fight in our last three ports o' call. I'll be no trouble, honest..."

"Aye, trouble may not come looking for ye, Nisar, but I be worried ye'll find it anyway. <FirstName>, ye be the nursemaid on this sally so keep 'im out of the clinker, understand me? We sail on the morning tides, come hell or high water. No trouble, now, ye hear?"

<StartAction>[Woman's Voice]</Start> "Those filthy men, all crying to each other about not getting paid. They were fit to break down my door not a minute ago but now there's only you. They're not still lurking around, are they?"
"Subtle..."
<StartAction>[Woman's Voice]</Start> "Excuse me? What kind of rescuer are you? Come closer to the keyhole so I can see who you are"
"Subtle..."
<StartAction>[Woman's Voice]</Start> "Dead? Well that will do nicely. One should feed their bodies to the deep! Come closer to the keyhole so I can see who you are, stranger."
<StartAction>[Woman's Voice]</Start> "Oh, what does it matter? I can't bear to be trapped in this room any longer - I need to be out at sea where I belong. Give me a second while I unbar the door."
"Ouch! The Cap'n ain't goin' to be pleased if he catches wind o' that, mate."

<StartAction>[Woman's Voice]</Start> "Then you've already done more than enough. Go to the Midnight Rose out in the harbor and beg payment from Allendry, her captain. With what I paid him for safe passage, he'll have plenty to spare..."
"Let me unbar the door for you - I can't bear to be trapped in this room any longer."
<StartAction>Leave.</Start>
"Open this door or I'll do it for you!"
"Are you Tasina? I've been sent to see to your aid."
"I'm <FirstName>, a sailor on the Midnight Rose."
"Yes, they're gone."
"Is who gone?"
"A handful of dead bandits. That'll come to 400 gold."
"They're dead. Now open the door."
"Enough of this prattle. Open the door."
"I expect payment for your protection, you know."
"Welcome to the Golden Apple. How can I help you, love?"

"Hmm... that's strange. I just let a group of others upstairs saying the same thing not five minutes ago. Bloody hell, why doesn't Allendry make all of you wear your uniforms on shore leave? It makes it so much easier to keep track of you."
"At any rate, here's the key. Go catch up with the others and I'll let you sort out who's who. Either way, Allendry made it clear that Lady Tasina was to be escorted to the Rose as soon as possible."
"I don't like the sound of this, <FirstName>..."
"Shoot, you must be the escort Allendry promised from the Midnight Rose, then! I should have known he wouldn't send someone out of uniform."

"I just let some shady-looking men upstairs saying *they* were Lady Tasina's escort just a minute ago. Allendry's going to have my hide for this. Here, take the key and see if you can head them off... I hope I haven't made too grave of an error."
"What do you mean?"
"Aye, we mean to see her safely to the docks."
"Well, go on! That girl may be needing your help and there's little an old wench like me can do."

"Ah! You're all right! I heard the scuffle upstairs. I'd ask what all the excitment be about but I learned many years back to keep my nose out of other people's business. It's the best way to ensure it stays attached to my face, quite frankly."
"Never mind."
"I'm here to meet Lady Tasina."
"We should get over to the Silver Sails. That's where the cargo's waiting and where Martins was supposed to meet the dockhands."
"I wouldn't mind stopping off at the tattoo parlor but the Cap'n says we should head to the Silver Sails first. That's where the cargo's waiting and where Martins was supposed to meet the dockhands."
"Aye. It never struck me as a wise plan in the first place, to be honest."
Text: 그가 고개를 끄덕입니다. "어차피 실제로 탐지를 피하고 있었던 건 아니니까요."

TextEng: "If we hurry we may still have time to hit the tattoo parlor before the Cap'n sounds the bell."
"Done and done, hey? The Cap'n will be pleased to be setting sail. Neverwinter's a good port but there's still nothing like the open sea."
"Can you hear the bell? I think the Cap'n wants all of us aboard the Rose and manning the ropes. Come on, let's go."
"We've still got a few minutes 'til the Cap'n be expecting us. Let's stop by the tattoo parlor before we shove off."
"All this walking is making me eager for the sea. Let's go find this Lady Tasina at the Golden Apple so we can haul anchor."
"I didn't like the look of those thugs harrassing this Lady Tasina lass, <FirstName>. I suggest we do something about it before things get out of hand..."

"Ha! The Cap'n says I'm the one always getting in trouble. Aye, I think the whole of the Golden Apple knows we're in town, now... We should check on this Lady Tasina and make sure that she's all right."
"It be getting light out, <FirstName>. We'd best see the Lady safe aboard the Rose or the Cap'n will set sail without us and tan our hides on his return."
"Aye, well done and the Rose be fit to set sail for Calimshan. We still have an hour or so while the Cap'n settles with the harbormaster so, if you need supplies, I suggest you get them soon."
"If you reckon you have all you need, report in to the Cap'n one last time so he knows that you're aboard."
"Ix-nay on the drunken elligerence-bay. Gotcha, mate."
Text: "그럼 전투가 시작될 때까지 최대한 조용히 할게요."

TextEng: "And I never did get around to showing you the tattoo parlor. We can still make it if you'd like to..."
"Aye, it be a funny place, this Spindrift Town. What's got you thinking, Cap'n?"
"Hey, do you think this town has a tattoo parlor? I've seen some nice ones on some of the blokes around the docks. Keep your eyes out."
"Aye, a tattooist in the clinker. That be ill news and worse luck. I vote we go speak with the Governor. I reckon it never hurts to be on the good side of a fine tattooist."
"Haha! I can smell the needles and ink already, <FirstName>. Let's go visit this tattooist and see what he has to offer."

"Aye, that Jolly Roger Special was a sight to see, <FirstName>, though I was rather hoping we'd spend that I.O.U. on ourselves. Oh well, I guess we'll just have to scrounge up the gold to pay him proper."
"Nice tattoo, mate. Hehe. Now we just have to find ourselves a proper crew so we can steal back the Rose."

"Hey, it's a shame about Tasina escaping aboard the Rose but look on the bright side: that tattoo makes you look real tough, mate. Come on, let's head down to the docks and find us another ship that can give chase."

"Come on, mate. Let's find us a proper crew for this Kolmarr chap and his Skull and Bones. The sooner we set sail, the sooner we'll find the Midnight Rose. And the sooner we find the Midnight Rose, the sooner we can claim Allendry's vengeance."
"Yo, tattoo-<man/woman>! Let's find some way to clear this storm so we can steal the Midnight Rose."
"Ha! I'm no creeper in the shadows, <FirstName>, but I'll do my best to avoid kicking buckets about if you think it will help."
Text: 그가 잠깐 비웃습니다. "난 그림자 속에 숨는 자가 아니야, <FirstName>, 하지만 네게 도움이 된다면 양동이를 발로 차는 건 피하도록 노력할게."

TextEng: "Hey, it's a shame about Tasina escaping aboard the Rose but look on the bright side: that tattoo makes you look real tough, mate. Come on, let's head down to the docks and find us another ship that can give chase."

"What are we waiting for, mate? We have everything we need to set sail aboard the Skull and Bones and give chase to that thief Tasina and the Rose! Come on, I'll race you down to the docks to speak with Master Kolmarr..."
"I think Master Kolmarr wants to speak with us, <FirstName>. He's waiting by the gangplank."

"I don't think it's safe to explore this island until we've picked up the map and supplies from Old Tom. I don't trust this Kolmarr chap one bit but, if there's going to be trouble, I'd rather be prepared."
"We still haven't found all those sigils like Kolmarr wanted. I hope that fool knows what he's doing. Come on, let's keep moving. I'll watch your back."
"We've filled all the sigils, <FirstName>. Come on, let's go find Kolmarr at the top of this hill before all these undead eat us alive."
"Aye, Cap'n, why the lollygagging about? The sooner we're off this island and pursuing the Midnight Rose, the better. Let's follow Kolmarr through those magic gates of his and be done with it."
"I'm in no mood for talking right now, <FirstName>. Let's go break the news to Old Tom, get the hells off this island, and go find the Midnight Rose like we should have been doing all along."
"We're sinking fast, Cap'n! You've got to bail water and get those holes plugged before the ship goes down. Garm and I will do what we can to keep the sahuagin off your back."
"Aye, good job, Cap'n! All the holes are plugged and we just have to take care of the last of these sahuagin!"
"Fair enough. I feel pretty stupid pounding away at things with just my knuckles, anyway."
Text: "그렇게 하죠. 어차피 자물쇠를 부숴야 할 테니까요."

TextEng: "That was a close one, Cap'n, but the Skull and Bones still floats and the sahuagin have all retreated. Look, the men have lowered another ladder. Let's go topside and make sure everyone's okay."

"There she is, <FirstName>, the Midnight Rose... Well, her deck's empty and there's no wind to fill her sail or ours but, other than that, she looks just like we left her. Let's go check the Captain's Quarters below and make sure all is well."
"You heard the Cap'n, <FirstName>. The priestesses are underneath those waves and we've got nowhere to go but down. Let Allendry take us down so we can finally avenge him and put his soul to rest..."
"I suppose this is a bad place to pass gas, isn't it? If you let one slip, there's no denying it... Come on, let's try to find this underwater temple the priestesses were looking for."
"Well, we've found the temple, for all the good it did us... Do you have any idea what the heck that thing was? Come on, let's check around back and see if there's some other way in..."

"Bloody dragons... Look, I can't speak for you but I came here to avenge Allendry's death and kill those foolish priestesses. You swore an oath to Allendry, too... Go talk to that dragon and do whatever it takes to get us into that temple."
"I sure as all hells hope you know where your allegiances lie, <FirstName>. Come on, the dragon can deal with this Dweller thing however it wants. Let's just get inside that temple and hunt Tasina."

"I can't believe you'd sell Allendry up the river like that, <FirstName>. Admittedly, the prospect of living again doesn't sound so bad... Let's find a way to kill this Dweller thing. You and I can settle any of our disputes safe aboard the Rose."
"Now's hardly the time to chat, <FirstName>! Cap'n Allendry's murder is almost avenged!"
"Hah! Need some help, do you?"
Text: "그러니까... 토미 실력이 또 필요한 거야? 언더마운틴엔 함정이 엄청 많거든, 알지? 혼자 가는 것보단 같이 가는 게 낫지."

TextEng: "I can try to bash it open, if need be. Don't go expecting anything subtle in that regard, though."
Text: 그가 어깨를 으쓱합니다. "필요하면 두들겨서 열 수는 있어. 그 점에선 은밀함은 기대하지 마."

TextEng: "Here? Wait 'til the Cap'n gets a load of this!"
Text: "영원히 여기 서 있을 생각은 없어... 근데 좋아. 일단 여기 있을게."

TextEng: "That's what I thought. Good thing the Cap'n sent me to watch after you."
Text: "좋아! 가자고!"

TextEng: "Bah, you've got enough help as it is. Don't tell the Cap'n but I think I might stop in for a drink at the Seedy Tavern."
Text: 토미가 당신의 동료들을 의심스럽게 바라봅니다. "흠. 재미 없게 굴고 싶진 않은데, 이미 사람이 꽤 많네. 좀 줄어들면 나한테 와서 소리 질러줘, 알았지?"

TextEng: "Is that you, <FirstName>? Well, I'll be! It's about time I saw a friendly face, <lad/lass> - I'd pretty much written you off as dead."
"Makes Spindrift here sound like an island paradise, mate. Welcome back to civilization, if you can call it that..."
"Rrrawk! Did you miss me? Rrrawk!"
"You, Poly? Never."
"Ssssss!"
"Uh... I can see that... He doesn't bite, does he?"
"Oy! Will do, mate."
Text: 그가 아무 말 없이 동의하며 고개를 끄덕입니다.

TextEng: "I'm best when rushing headlong into the thick of combat, believe it or not. Just point me in the right direction and let me go, mate."
Text: 그가 고개를 끄덕입니다. "믿기 힘들겠지만, 전투의 한복판으로 돌진할 때 가장 효과적이에요."

TextEng: "Any other advice you care to hand out?"

"I wonder what happened out there... Martins ain't the type to drop a job half-done and he's got an impatient streak a league wide. I wouldn't want to be a dockhand on the wrong side of him, that's for sure... Anything else you wanted?"
"If there's something in it for me... What do you need?"
"Hmph. That's so, is it? Care to narrow it down a little? Let me rattle off the list of what I know."
Text: "제 마법은 당신이 사용하실 수 있어요. 어떤 주문을 시전하길 원하세요?"

TextEng: "Nice choice. Are you sure you want me to do this?"
Text: "확실하세요?"

TextEng: "Aye, that's the fun part. Are you interested in a short-term pick-me-up or something with long-term staying power?"
Text: "현명한 결정이에요. 많은 전투가 준비 부족으로 패배하죠. 어떤 종류의 강화 주문을 시전하길 원하세요?"

TextEng: "Fair enough. Who should I target with this happy barrage of joy?"
Text: "그럼 제 마법의 대상은 누구여야 하나요?"

TextEng: "All right. Let's see how many of these I can remember off the top of my head..."
Text: "금방 끝날 거예요."

TextEng: "Sorry, mate. I'm all spent. Maybe after we've had a chance to catch some rest."
"My rage is best used when there's trouble afoot. Are you sure you want me to unleash it here and now?"
Text: 하프오크가 자네에게 이상한 표정을 짓습니다. "내 분노는 전투에서 사용하는 게 최선이야. 지금 내 분노를 폭발시키길 확실히 원하나?"

TextEng: "Aye, I was born a barbarian and soon found I had some talent for sorcery as well. I'm currently focusing my training exclusively on my magical studies and ignoring my barbarian heritage, as you suggested."
Text: "현재 당신이 제안하신 대로, 암살자로서의 기술을 향상시키는 데만 집중하고 마법사로서의 훈련은 무시하고 있어요."

TextEng: "Aye, I was born a barbarian and soon found I had some talent for sorcery as well. I'm currently focusing my training exclusively on my barbarian heritage and ignoring my magical studies as you suggested."
Text: "현재 당신이 제안하신 대로, 마법사로서의 기술을 향상시키는 데만 집중하고 암살자로서의 훈련은 무시하고 있어요."

TextEng: "The Cap'n gave me an order, <FirstName>, and I ain't one to take him lightly. I'm to stick to you like tar and see to it that the Rose is ready to sail by dawn. So quit stalling, mate. We've got work to do."
Text: 그는 눈살을 찌푸리며, 걱정스러워 보입니다. "원한다면요. 피할 수 있다면 당신을 적절한 방어 없이 두고 떠나고 싶지 않소."

TextEng: "Aye, balance. That's the tricky bit, isn't it? Fine and good, then. Whenever one class lags behind, I'll focus on it exclusively until my abilities are equal once again. Thanks for the advice."
Text: "알겠어요. 마법사와 암살자로서의 능력 균형을 맞추도록 노력하겠어요. 한 직업이 뒤처질 때마다, 능력이 다시 균형을 이룰 때까지 그것에 집중하겠어요."

TextEng: "Aye, I was born a barbarian and soon found I had some talent for sorcery as well. I'm currently trying to bring the two into balance. Whenever I fall behind in one area, I try to become more experienced in it until the two are equal."
Text: "현재 마법 능력과 암살자 기술 사이의 균형을 맞추려고 노력하고 있어요. 한 영역에서 뒤처질 때마다, 두 가지가 균형을 이룰 때까지 더 경험을 쌓으려고 해요."

TextEng: "That's the best advice I've heard all day!"
Text: "물론이죠."

TextEng: "Trying to civilize me, are you? Very well, I'll do my best to become a better sorcerer. Thanks for the advice."
Text: "암살자로서의 제 기술이 주문보다 더 유용하다고 생각하신다면, 암살자로서 경험을 쌓는 데만 집중하겠어요."

TextEng: "We're a long way from the jungles of Chult but it will feel good to return to my roots as a barbarian. Thanks for the advice."
Text: "제 주문이 암살자 기술보다 그룹에 더 가치 있다고 생각하신다면, 마법사로서 더 많은 경험을 쌓는 데 집중하겠어요."

TextEng: "Who, me? Is it all right if I lie? Ha! Very well, hand it over and I'll see if there's anything in there I might recognize."
Text: "마법 지식은 심연에 있을 때 들은 몇 가지 이야기에 국한되어 있어요. 가지고 있는 것들을 살펴보고 알아보는 게 있으면 말씀드릴게요... 하지만 별로 자신 없어요."

TextEng: "Anything else you're wanting, mate?"
"You want to pilfer it, more like it... Bah, go ahead. It all be standard issue anyhow."
Text: 그가 배낭을 벗어 아무 말 없이 당신에게 건넵니다.

TextEng: "The boats are usually better and the shore leaves less creepy but, other than that, things are about the same. I sure do miss Cap'n Allendry, though."
"I don't really know. I guess he was the first one to ever really give me a chance. He was a good cap'n and he died for his ship. He earned my respect... If we don't make Tasina pay, who will?"

"Not bloody likely. You, Poly, and myself are the only known survivors of the Midnight Rose and I'm not letting you out of my sight another wink, mate. If we want the Rose back, we have to stick together."
"Ha! I wish I knew, <FirstName>. But I don't think we could turn back now if we tried... Come on, it's best we keep moving."
"You've come all this way, too, you know. We make a pretty good team. Garm and Poly aren't half bad either."
"Do you really think now's the best time to be talking about it, lass? Once we've completed this task of Kolmarr's, we can sit down and have us a heart-to-heart."
"I really don't think you want me to answer that right now, <FirstName>... I'll be all right. Just give me some time to cool my temper, that's all."

"You know what, <FirstName>? I should be. I really should be mad as all hells about this mess but I'm not. I've been thinking about it: I've got you, don't I? I've seen things I'd never have had the chance to see otherwise, been things I'd never have been..."

"Life is all about what you make of it and I guess death must be too. When we're done with this, maybe we can find ourselves a little graveyard to call our own, raise some vicious little zombie babies and make a go of it..."

"Maybe it's not what I expected but it's something and it's you and I and it's... I don't know, <FirstName>. I love you and I want to spend the rest of this... whatever-it-is with you... Now come on, we have some work beneath these waves that needs our doing."

"I don't normally turn into the shambling dead but, if you put that aside for a moment, it's been a pretty typical leg of the journey. I'm not entirely convinced we'll ever actually make it to Calimshan but I don't think they'd take well to us in this state, anyways."
"You know, I'd have to say that I haven't truly known a normal day since you became Cap'n, <FirstName>... Actually, there was that one day when... No, no, that one wasn't normal either."
"Aye, it's a free island. Ask what you will."
"Ha! It's a little late for that now, don't you think?"
"Well, we don't have enough crew to sail by, that's for sure. I'm at a loss as to where to look, though. I guess we'll just have to keep our eyes peeled and ask around..."

"Well, we don't have enough crew to sail by, that's for sure. I can't think of any potential crewmembers in particular but I've heard rumors of a fight club in one of the warehouses hereabouts. It sounds like as good a place to start as any."

"Well, we don't have enough crew to sail by, that's for sure. I can't think of any potential crewmembers in particular but we haven't been to the temple yet. As much as I loathe the Umberlants, they definitely seem to be the lifeblood of this town."

"Well, we don't have enough crew to sail by, that's for sure. I can't think of any potential crewmembers in particular but we haven't been to the lighthouse yet. Maybe the resident lighthouse gnome has some advice."

"Well, we don't have enough crew to sail by, that's for sure. I can't think of any potential crewmembers in particular but we haven't checked in with the Governor yet. Maybe he'll have some suggestions."

"Well, we don't have enough crew to sail by, that's for sure. I can't think of any potential crewmembers in particular but we haven't been to the tavern yet. It's called the Monkey's Cutlass. Come on, let's check it out."
"Shakey McGuire seems a little off his rocker but desperate times call for desperate measures, I suppose. We're short on crew and if he fills a gap, then I say we go for it."
"That Minotaur, Redtip, sure would be a fine addition, though I'd rather not be the one to face him in the ring. He'd be a good one to have watching our backs if we ever got into trouble, however."
"Sir Francis is a gullible fool but a fine pirate nonetheless. If we can get him that ring he's looking for, I'm sure he'll come aboard."

"That priestess, Sweetie Marie, is a pretty lass and nowhere near as zealous as the rest of that foul brood. Charm her a little and maybe she'll come aboard. Maybe she'll teach us a few tricks we can use against Tasina..."

"Ha! Beating anything that comes within reach be a perfectly acceptable tactic, if you ask me. It helps to be a little bit drunk, mind you. If there's something specific you need me to do, though, just say the word."
Text: "어떻게 행동해야 하는지 말씀해주시면 그렇게 노력하겠습니다."

TextEng: "That Paulson fellow in the Monkey's Cutlass may have a wooden leg and a broken heart but he's no slouch as a sailor. I can't believe I'm saying this but maybe you should seduce him with a little bit of love and alcohol until he comes around."
"That lighthouse gnome, Vantabular, seemed a friendly sort and no doubt he knows these islands like the back of his hand. An unlikely candidate, perhaps, but I think he'd prove his worth."
"Well, if Vengaul Bloodsail's eager for that Sceptre of Storms, I say we give it to him. It'd be good luck to have a man of his experience aboard, I think, and the head of the Bloodsailors, no less."
"Well, if Honeypea's eager for that Sceptre of Storms, I say we give it to her. It'd be good luck to have a Blackriver Bandit aboard, I think."

"It sounds like this Longneck Langer fellow is in a sticky spot, stuck as he is in the Governor's prison. Scheduled for a proper hanging, no less. He may not be a great pirate but he's a fine sailor and it wouldn't be right to see him hung."
"Aye, I've heard good tales of that Whipped Willigan chap that the barkeep mentioned. I think he'd be a great addition to this crew we're forming."

"We've gathered a big enough crew to steal the Rose but I don't like the thought of trying to make our escape in this kind of weather. Even with our sails reefed up, this wind would snap the mast like kindling as soon as we left harbor."
"A crew won't do us much good without a ship. Let's head down to the docks to see if there's anything there we can beg, borrow or steal..."

"Aye, the Skull and Bones is no Midnight Rose but we've gathered enough of a crew to sail her. I say we go talk to this this Kolmarr chap who owns her and get him to hoist the signal flag so we can embark and give chase to the witch, Tasina."

"She's a priestess of Umberlee, <lad/lass>, and for that alone I'd never trust her. Add in the fact that she killed our Cap'n and stole our ship and I'd say my temper boils over. Her life is forfeit, <FirstName>, and don't you forget it."
"Good. I don't want you changing any more of them, either."
"Rrrawk! Tasina's dreamy..."
"Shut up, dumb bird, or I'll tear that beak right off..."

"It's a long story. After Lady Tasina tossed me overboard, I was lucky enough to catch hold of some passing driftwood. I managed to convince the sharks that there was easier prey about and, after two days at sea, a fishing trawler found me."

"Anyhow, they dropped me off here in Spindrift, right next to the Midnight Rose, no less. Until you showed up, I was skulking about the docks, trying to stay out of sight of the priestesses and find a way to steal back our ship."
"Quite the catch! Rrrawk! Quite the catch!"
"Hey now, when I said it's a free island, I didn't mean *that* free! Without a little bit of warning, questions like that are liable to give a man whiplash, woman!"

"...That came out wrong, didn't it... Look, I find you very attractive, <FirstName>. Dangerously so. After we lost the Rose, I was horrified by the thought you might be dead... I spent all my time at the docks, praying some ship would bring you in..."
"Let's just take this one step at a time, all right, lass?"
"Nisar and <FirstName>, sitting in a tree, K-I-S-S-I-N-G. Rrrawk!"
